summary: The run's deaths=5 kill_credits=5 are the five Mav torpedo bombers shot down by Dunlap, Northampton and SaltLakeCity after they dropped; no ship sank and not one point of the mission's 2596.8 damage is attributable to a torpedo. All five torpedoes entered the water and swam at 30.9 m/s, and all five missed.

routines.name: BSP_BotStateTorpedoGoAway_Tick
routines.coverage: complete as a listing read: body 009D0F10-009D1210 (Ghidra live, checked per call site), both arms, all three returns at 009D1153, 009D11ED and 009D120E, every constant checked at both widths against its load. The reconstruction and the host binding are NOT written.

host_steps.note: Second argument is the literal 1.0 from 009D107A FLD1 / 009D1084 SUB ESP,8 / 009D1087 FSTP [ESP+4], capping the climb at class+1ECh * 1.0 = 0.1854 rad for the Mav. Unbound in this host.

The low arm, taken when unitY <= 20.0 (00CE3930): altitude 1000.0 (00CE3804) with the same literal 1.0 reference, then cmd+2C0h = state+18h and cmd+2CCh = 2. This is the climb-away proper and the aircraft that ditch at 69.6 m/s are in exactly this altitude band with nothing running it.

attribution.killed_by: Mav1 Dunlap 133.50 s; Mav2 Northampton 136.95 s; Mav3 Northampton 109.15 s; Mav4 SaltLakeCity 134.25 s; Mav5 SaltLakeCity 109.80 s
attribution.ships_sunk: none; every other unit row carries sunk_at -1.00
attribution.damage_decomposition: five Mavs at 450 taken each = 2250.0, plus SaltLakeCity 347.0, equals 2597.0 against the summary's 2596.8. SaltLakeCity's 347 is exactly the side-1 guns' dealt column: CB2 127 + Coastal Gun 03 79 + Coastal Gun 02 53 + Coastal Gun 01 88.
attribution.torpedo_damage: none. hit_records=111 and entity_impacts=111 are the gun-hit count.

torpedo_fate.release_time_s: about 78 to 88, bracketed by gunnery step 1600 t=80.00
torpedo_fate.release_range_m: about 700, interpolated from the aim census at tick 151 (1084 m) and the timer's first fire at aim tick 253
torpedo_fate.outcome: none hit. The host's swim is not a stub: the round is levelled onto the surface plane at the swim speed with its launch heading, gravity disabled through the flight state's classDesc+20h flag, and continues through the same entity sweep, so it can hit.
torpedo_fate.open: Whether anything in the chain leads a moving target over the roughly 23 seconds of run is unread. 009D1360 writes approach+A0h (the fall lead) and approach+98h (the run time), and 009D3D12 reads +98h as the bias of the engagement estimate at +F8h; whether either reaches the commanded heading is not established. The commanded heading is approach+94h, the bearing to the plan target at approach+ACh/+B0h, plus the sector offset approach+5Ch.

validation.note: read-only analysis of an existing run; no code changed in this part of the packet

corrections.is: 009D0F10-009D1210. 009D1153 is the FIRST of three RET 4; 009D1032 JBE jumps past it to a second arm at 009D1156 whose returns are at 009D11ED and 009D120E, and the 009D1194 call site lives in that arm.
corrections.evidence: bsp.py ghidra proto on 009D0F10, 009D109C, 009D10FF and 009D1194 all answer body 009d0f10 - 009d1210.

corrections.was: state+1Ch, the altitude both 009D109C and 009D1194 command, has no producer in this document.
corrections.is: 009D0D90 BSP_BotStateTorpedoGoAway_Enter (body 009D0D90-009D0F04) writes it at 009D0E88 as UniformFloatRange(50.0, 100.0) plus approach+78h + approach+74h when approach+132h is set, else ctl+394h. It writes state+2Ch, +24h, +28h, +30h, +34h and +20h too.
corrections.evidence: The plate comment on 009D0D90 carries packet cc8_torpedo_goaway_release's extent correction past 009D0E3A to 009D0F04. I had read only docs/TORPEDO_GOAWAY_RELEASE.md section (2)'s summary line and not that document's own correction section.

goaway_tick.structure: high = unitY > state+20h (009D0F3C JBE -> 0); 009D0C10 heading update; countdown state+28h -= dt while approach+90h < state+24h - 100.0; state+30h += dt; re-seed state+34h = jitter(3.0, 6.0), state+28h = jitter(row+10h, row+14h) + state+34h, state+30h = -state+34h/2 when state+28h < 0 and high; then the manoeuvre window state+30h < state+34h selects the arm.
goaway_tick.window_arm: 009FB800(state+1Ch, 1.0) and a roll cmd+2C4h = clamp(2 * state+2Ch * state+30h, -1.2, 1.2) with cmd+2CCh = 1 when unitY > 20.0; otherwise 009FB800(1000.0, 1.0) with cmd+2C0h = state+18h and cmd+2CCh = 2.
goaway_tick.post_window_arm: 009FB800(state+1Ch, 1.0) always; then cmd+2C0h = state+18h with mode 2 when high, else cmd+2C4h = 0.0 with mode 1.
goaway_tick.unread_dependencies: ONE remains: 009D0C10 BSP_BotStateTorpedoGoAway_UpdateGeometry, body 009D0C10-009D0D87, called first at 009D0F46, which fills state+18h, the heading both arms write to cmd+2C0h. Nothing else in the band writes it. state+1Ch, +2Ch, +24h, +28h, +30h, +34h and +20h all have producers in the enter 009D0D90.
